scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('out', '.', {recursive: true}); ['create','practice','result','history','print'].forEach(p => { if (fs.existsSync('out/' + p + '/index.html')) fs.copyFileSync('out/' + p + '/index.html', p + '.html'); }); fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f => f.endsWith('.txt')).forEach(f => fs.unlinkSync(f));"
